nodes.name: Set Config
nodes.notes:
CONFIGURATION NODE - Edit these values for your setup.

Required credentials:
- Google Calendar OAuth2
- Gmail OAuth2
- Google Sheets OAuth2
- (Optional) Twilio API

All times use the timezone specified below.

nodes.name: Booking Webhook
nodes.notes:
Receives booking requests.

Expected payload:
- first_name (required)
- last_name (required)
- email (required)
- phone (optional)
- service_type (optional)
- requested_start (ISO datetime, required)
- requested_end (optional)
- notes (optional)
- consent_sms (optional boolean)

nodes.name: Parse Booking Request
nodes.notes: Extracts and normalizes booking data from webhook payload. Generates unique appointment_id.

nodes.name: Validate Required Fields
nodes.notes: Checks that all required fields are present: first_name, last_name, email, requested_start

assignments.name: error.message
assignments.value: Missing required fields. Please provide: first_name, last_name, email, and requested_start.

nodes.name: Set Validation Error
nodes.notes: Sets error message for missing required fields

nodes.name: Validate Booking Constraints
nodes.notes:
Validates:
- Working days and hours
- Minimum notice period
- Maximum days ahead
- Email format
- Calculates buffers and dedupe key

nodes.name: Constraints Valid?
nodes.notes: Routes based on whether booking passes all constraint validations

nodes.name: Set Constraint Error
nodes.notes: Sets error for constraint validation failures

nodes.name: Check Dedupe in Sheets
nodes.notes: Checks if this booking request already exists (dedupe by email + start time + service type)

nodes.name: Is Duplicate?
nodes.notes: Checks if dedupe key already exists in Sheets

assignments.name: error.message
assignments.value: This booking request has already been submitted. Please check your email for confirmation.

nodes.name: Set Duplicate Error
nodes.notes: Sets error for duplicate booking attempts

nodes.name: Check Calendar Availability
nodes.notes: Queries Google Calendar for any existing events during the requested time slot (including buffers)

nodes.name: Is Slot Available?
nodes.notes: Routes to booking creation if no conflicts, or to suggest alternatives if conflicts exist

nodes.name: Find Alternative Slots
nodes.notes: Calculates 3 alternative available time slots within the next 7 days when requested slot is unavailable

nodes.name: Generate Secure Token
nodes.notes:
Creates HMAC SHA256 signed token for reschedule/cancel links.

Token format: base64url(payload).signature
Payload: appointment_id, client_email, expires_at
Valid for 30 days

nodes.name: Create Calendar Event
nodes.notes:
Creates the calendar event with:
- Title: Service with Client Name
- Description with all details
- Google Meet link (if enabled)
- Sends invite to attendees

nodes.name: Extract Event Details
nodes.notes: Extracts calendar event ID and Google Meet link from created event

nodes.name: Log Booking to Sheets
nodes.notes:
Records the new booking in Google Sheets with all details including:
- Appointment info
- Calendar event ID
- Reschedule/cancel URLs
- Reminder tracking flags

Requires Twilio credentials to be configured.
Update 'from' number with your Twilio phone number.

nodes.name: Respond Success
nodes.notes: Returns success response to the booking form with appointment details

nodes.name: Respond Conflict with Alternatives
nodes.notes: Returns conflict response with 3 alternative time slots

nodes.name: Log Error to Sheets
